title: Minister Blames Opposition
body: Israeli Culture Minister Miki Zohar blamed opposition rhetoric for a deadly anti-draft rally tragedy. A bus driver continued driving 500 meters after hitting a protester, 14-year-old Yosef Eisenthal, who was trapped beneath the vehicle.

title: West Gate Shooting Fatality
body: A woman was shot and killed in Lakewood's West Gate apartment complex, prompting a major emergency response. The shooting occurred at an apartment on Hillside Boulevard, with details of the circumstances still unknown.

title: Rabbi Uri Lupolianski Passes Away
body: Rabbi Uri Lupolianski z”l, founder of Yad Sarah and former Yerushalayim mayor, dies at 74 after a serious illness. Levayah to take place Thursday.
